ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (11) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Turgenev's prose poem is translated closely, keeping «благоговея» / «благоговел» (blagogoveya / blagogovel, 'in awe' / 'stood in awe') as a repeated pair; the attribution follows the print, «И. С. Тургенев» ('I. S. Turgenev').
